items.text: Puka Nacua listed DOUBTFUL (hip/groin) for Sunday vs DEN; ETR/Levitan and Rapoport note not expected to play, with Adams carrying the load. McVay: more unlikely than likely; possible Week 4 return.
items.why: DNP all week; McVay comments and ETR list
items.implication: Adams primary target/routes bump; Nacua sit
items.opportunity: Davante Adams elevated routes/target rate without Nacua (historical 42% target rate on routes)

items.text: Commanders officially ruled QB Jayden Daniels OUT Sunday vs SEA (elbow). Rapoport: positive longer-term news, Mariota starts.
items.implication: Mariota start; McLaurin still viable but tough SEA matchup and low team total
items.opportunity: McLaurin historical 25% TS / 14+ PPG with Mariota; reverse any full fade
items.conflict: Berry hates McLaurin this week on matchup/total despite Mariota history

items.text: Texans ruled WR Nico Collins OUT Sunday at IND due to hamstring. Confirmed on Schefter OUT list and ETR.
items.implication: Schultz and other Texans pass-catchers see target spike
items.opportunity: Dalton Schultz team-high target share (28% last week without Collins); Colts allow 4th-most TE yards

items.text: Steelers ruled RB Rico Dowdle OUT (toe) vs CIN. Jaylen Warren questionable (shoulder) but expected to lead.
items.opportunity: Coach: Warren will lead group; Levitan expects heavy checkdowns given Rodgers vertical struggles; Homer/Heidenreich backups

items.text: ETR projecting Jaylen Warren (shoulder), Mike Evans (hip), Brock Bowers (knee) IN despite QUESTIONABLE tags. Seeking early clarity on Flowers/Mitchell/DJ Moore.
items.why: ETR internal projection based on practice/news
items.implication: Start Warren/Evans/Bowers if no further downgrade; monitor Flowers
items.opportunity: Full roles if active; Bowers TE upside

items.text: JK Dobbins and RJ Harvey listed IN (off injury report, good to go) vs LAR. Jonah Coleman OUT (ankle).
items.implication: Committee returns; reverse Coleman stash beneficiaries
items.opportunity: Dobbins/Harvey split; Coleman out removes prior beneficiary path

items.text: Malik Nabers and Travis Etienne listed IN for Sunday. Nabers full participant Friday.
items.why: ETR IN list; full practice for Nabers
items.implication: Nabers full role return; Etienne still limited committee (Berry hate on role)
items.opportunity: Nabers routes/targets back; Etienne only ~49% touches/38% 3rd-down snaps
items.conflict: Berry hates Etienne on poor utilization even if active

items.text: With Dowdle OUT, Jaylen Warren will lead Steelers RBs; expect heavy checkdown volume as Rodgers vertical game has failed. Projecting Warren in despite Q (shoulder). Backups: Homer + Heidenreich.
items.why: Coach quote on lead role + Rodgers checkdown lean + ETR projecting in
items.opportunity: Lead carries + checkdowns; 15+ touch history strong PPG

items.text: Jonathon Brooks expected IR (core surgery, 6-8 weeks); Chuba Hubbard firmly lead back (RB14 util), AJ Dillon primary backup. ETR lists Brooks OUT.
items.why: Surgery timeline per reports; ETR OUT

items.text: Davante Adams has run 142 routes without Nacua as a Ram, targeted on 42%. Results in Nacua-miss games strong (e.g. 8-195-2). Projecting elevated role with Nacua doubtful.
items.why: Route/target rate data without Nacua + Rapoport Adams can carry load
items.implication: Adams WR1/2 with high target ceiling
items.opportunity: 42% target rate on routes; primary option vs DEN

items.text: ETR Week 3 projections live; Jahmyr Gibbs sets new record ceiling projection at 44.0 (avg of top 25th percentile sim outcomes).
items.why: Sim ceiling record in ETR projections
items.opportunity: High snap/route/carry ceiling in Lions offense

items.text: Berry LOVES Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest RB rush yards prop (88.5); DAL 30th in rush D allowing 173.5 YPG.
items.opportunity: High carry volume vs weak run D

items.text: Berry LOVES Chase Brown (@PIT, 20+ touches/15% TS, PIT soft vs RBs), Chris Olave (vs LV, double-digit targets, LV allows 18.7 YPR to WRs), Christian Watson (vs ATL, WR8 util + RZ share), Dalton Schultz (@IND, 28% TS sans Collins, IND soft vs TEs).
items.opportunity: Brown volume lock; Olave air yards; Watson RZ; Schultz targets with Collins out

items.text: Berry HATES Rhamondre Stevenson (@JAX, 31% snaps/5 touches post-fumble, JAX stout vs RBs), Travis Etienne (vs LV, only 49% touches/38% 3rd-down even with Kamara), Terry McLaurin (vs SEA, fewest WR fantasy pts allowed + low WAS total).
items.implication: Sit/fade; Henderson rising but Berry still ranks Stevenson ahead slightly
items.opportunity: Henderson 65% snaps/16 touches after Stevenson fumble; monitor split
items.conflict: Henderson usage rising vs Stevenson ranking preference
